mapper.select: select w.warehouse_code as warehouseCode, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, w.city, w.return_enabled as returnEnabled, w.alliance_share_enabled as allianceShareEnabled, w.status from ry_business.ry_rental_warehouse w where w.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and w.member_id = #{memberId} and w.is_delete = 0 order by w.sort_no asc, w.create_time desc, w.warehouse_id desc limit #{limit}

select p.product_code as productCode, p.product_name as productName, cast(p.product_type as char) as productType, cast(p.stock_mode as char) as stockMode, p.brand, p.model_name as modelName, p.custom_flag as customFlag, p.status from ry_business.ry_rental_product p where p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and p.member_id = #{memberId} and p.is_delete = 0 order by p.create_time desc, p.product_id desc limit #{limit}

select p.package_code as packageCode, p.package_name as packageName, coalesce((select max(mp.model_name) from ry_business.ry_rental_product mp where mp.tenant_id = p.tenant_id and mp.member_id = p.member_id and mp.model_id = p.model_id and mp.is_delete = 0 and cast(mp.product_type as char) in ('1', 'device')), '-') as modelName, p.source_type as sourceType, p.custom_flag as customFlag, v.version_no as versionNo, v.version_status as versionStatus, p.status from ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_package p left join ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_package_version v on v.package_id = p.package_id and v.tenant_id = p.tenant_id and v.member_id = p.member_id and v.version_status = 1 and v.is_delete = 0 where p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and p.member_id = #{memberId} and p.is_delete = 0 order by p.create_time desc, p.package_id desc limit #{limit}

select w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, p.product_code as productCode, p.product_name as productName, cast(p.product_type as char) as productType, coalesce(i.total_quantity, 0) as totalQuantity, coalesce(i.available_quantity, 0) as availableQuantity, coalesce(i.reserved_quantity, 0) as reservedQuantity, coalesce(i.rented_quantity, 0) as rentedQuantity, coalesce(i.repairing_quantity, 0) as repairingQuantity, coalesce(i.damaged_quantity, 0) as damagedQuantity, i.status from ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_inventory i left join ry_business.ry_rental_product p on p.product_id = i.product_id and p.tenant_id = i.tenant_id and p.member_id = i.member_id and p.is_delete = 0 left join ry_business.ry_rental_warehouse w on w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id and w.tenant_id = i.tenant_id and w.member_id = i.member_id and w.is_delete = 0 where i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and i.member_id = #{memberId} and i.is_delete = 0 order by i.create_time desc, i.inventory_id desc limit #{limit}

select coalesce((select count(1) from ry_business.ry_rental_order o where o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and o.member_id = #{memberId} and o.is_delete = 0), 0) as totalOrderCount, coalesce((select count(1) from ry_business.ry_rental_order o where o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and o.member_id = #{memberId} and o.order_status in (10, 15) and o.is_delete = 0), 0) as pendingOrderCount, coalesce((select count(1) from ry_business.ry_rental_order o where o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and o.member_id = #{memberId} and o.order_status in (20, 25, 30, 40, 45, 70) and o.is_delete = 0), 0) as activeOrderCount, coalesce((select count(1) from ry_business.ry_rental_order o where o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and o.member_id = #{memberId} and o.order_status = 50 and o.is_delete = 0), 0) as completedOrderCount, coalesce((select count(1) from ry_business.ry_rental_order o where o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and o.member_id = #{memberId} and (o.order_status in (60, 65) or cast(o.time_effect_status as char) in ('1', 'overdue')) and o.is_delete = 0), 0) as overdueOrderCount, coalesce((select count(1) from ry_business.ry_rental_after_sales_case c where c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and c.member_id = #{memberId} and c.is_delete = 0), 0) as afterSalesCaseCount, coalesce((select count(1) from ry_business.ry_rental_after_sales_case c where c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and c.member_id = #{memberId} and c.case_status = 0 and c.is_delete = 0), 0) as openAfterSalesCaseCount, coalesce((select count(1) from ry_business.ry_rental_logistics_order l where l.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and l.member_id = #{memberId} and l.is_delete = 0), 0) as logisticsCount, coalesce((select count(1) from ry_business.ry_rental_logistics_order l where l.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and l.member_id = #{memberId} and l.route_status in ('0', '1', '3') and l.is_delete = 0), 0) as pendingRouteCount, coalesce((select count(1) from ry_business.ry_rental_logistics_order l where l.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and l.member_id = #{memberId} and l.abnormal_flag = 1 and l.route_status not in ('2', '4') and l.is_delete = 0), 0) as abnormalLogisticsCount, coalesce((select count(1) from ry_business.ry_rental_inventory_alert_event e where e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and e.member_id = #{memberId} and e.alert_status in (0, 1) and e.is_delete = 0), 0) as openInventoryAlertCount, coalesce((select count(1) from ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance_dispute d where d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and (d.initiator_member_id = #{memberId} or d.respondent_member_id = #{memberId}) and d.dispute_status in (0, 1, 2, 3) and d.is_delete = 0), 0) as openAllianceDisputeCount
